rules.title: Security deposit limit and permitted upfront charges
rules.quote: At or prior to the commencement of any tenancy, no lessor or agent of the lessor may require a tenant or prospective tenant to pay, to the lessor or to an agent of the lessor, any amount in excess of the following: (i) rent for the first full month of occupancy; and, (ii) rent for the last full month of occupancy calculated at the same rate as the first month; and, (iii) a security deposit equal to the first month's rent provided that such security deposit is deposited as required by subsection (3) and that the tenant is given the statement of condition as required by subsection (2)
rules.summary: Landlords may only collect first month's rent, last month's rent, a security deposit equal to one month's rent, and the cost of a key and lock at the start of a tenancy.
rules.key_value: 1 month's rent (security deposit); first + last month's rent
rules.effective_date_evidence: Introductory paragraph of clause (b) of subsection (1) as amended by 2025, 9, Secs. 54 and 55 effective August 1, 2025. See 2025, 9, Sec. 136.
rules.exemption_note: Does not apply to vacation or recreational leases of 100 days or less
rules.penalty: Treble damages plus 5% interest, court costs, and attorney's fees for certain violations

rules.title: Security deposit interest requirement
rules.quote: A lessor of residential real property who holds a security deposit pursuant to this section for a period of one year or longer from the commencement of the term of the tenancy shall, beginning with the first day of the tenancy, pay interest at the rate of five per cent per year, or other such lesser amount of interest as has been received from the bank where the deposit has been held payable to the tenant at the end of each year of the tenancy.
rules.summary: Landlords must pay tenants 5% annual interest (or the lesser rate earned from the bank) on security deposits held for one year or longer.
rules.coverage_text: Applies to security deposits held for one year or longer
rules.exemption_note: Does not apply to vacation or recreational leases of 100 days or less
rules.penalty: Treble damages plus 5% interest, court costs, and attorney's fees if interest not paid within 30 days of termination

rules.title: Security deposit return with itemized deductions
rules.quote: The lessor shall, within thirty days after the termination of occupancy under a tenancy-at-will or the end of the tenancy as specified in a valid written lease agreement, return to the tenant the security deposit or any balance thereof; provided, however, that the lessor may deduct from such security deposit for the following: (i) any unpaid rent or water charges which have not been validly withheld or deducted pursuant to any general or special law (ii) any unpaid increase in real estate taxes which the tenant is obligated to pay pursuant to a tax escalation clause which conforms to the requirements of section fifteen C; and (iii) a reasonable amount necessary to repair any damage caused to the dwelling unit by the tenant or any person under the tenant's control or on the premises with the tenant's consent, reasonable wear and tear excluded.
rules.summary: Landlords must return the security deposit within 30 days after termination of tenancy, with deductions allowed only for unpaid rent, certain taxes, or damage beyond reasonable wear and tear, with itemized documentation required.
rules.exemption_note: Does not apply to vacation or recreational leases of 100 days or less
rules.penalty: Treble damages plus 5% interest, court costs, and attorney's fees for failure to return within 30 days or provide itemized list
